content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for KVS Saraipali Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for KVS Saraipali Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for KVS Saraipali Recruitment 2026 is scheduled for 26 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they report on this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Special Educator and Educational Counsellor posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies, with 1 post for Special Educator and 1 post for Educational Counsellor.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Special Educator post?
faq.answer: For the Special Educator post, candidates need to have passed XIIth with a two-year D.Ed. Special Education or equivalent RCI recognized qualifications and be CTET Qualified.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification for the Educational Counsellor post?
faq.answer: The Educational Counsellor post requires a B.A. / B.Sc. in Psychology with a certificate of Diploma in Counseling or equivalent, along with a minimum of 1 year of experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for these positions?
faq.answer: The age limit for all posts is between a minimum of 18 years and a maximum of 65 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for these contractual positions?
faq.answer: The salary for the Special Educator post is Rs. 21250/- per month, and for the Educational Counsellor post, it is Rs. 26250/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for KVS Saraipali Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process includes an Oral Interview, a Demo Class, and potentially a Written Test if more than 20 candidates apply for a single post.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview scheduled to take place?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will take place at Kendriya Vidyalaya Saraipali, located in Saraipali, Chhattisgarh, PIN 493558.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if applicable), and category certificates (if applicable).
